title: Sales Head (lubricants, automotive oils, fuel retail is mandatory)
description:
**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Sales Head to lead and grow our lubricants business. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience from the same industry (lubricants, automotive oils, fuel retail etc.) and can drive revenue, expand the dealer/distributor network, and lead a team of field sales executives.

Primarily customer:

Manufacturing industries in Bhiwadi and surrounding industrial area like Dharuhera, Manesar, Binola, Rewari, Bawal, Neemrana- Ghiloth, Behror Industrial Area etc.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own the overall sales strategy and revenue targets.

· Expand and manage the team, customers.

· Build and lead a team of field sales executives; set targets, monitor performance etc.

· Identify new business leads and execute them.

· Track competitor activity, pricing, and market trends in the lubricants segment.

· Prepare and present regular sales MIS and forecasts to management

· Ensure timely collections and healthy channel credit management

**Requirements**

· Graduate / Masters (Sales & Marketing preferred)

· **Same-field experience required - prior experience in lubricants, automotive oils, fuel retail is mandatory**

**· 5–7 years of overall sales experience, with at least 1-2 years in a leadership/team-handling role.**

· Proven track record of achieving sales targets and growing dealer networks

· Strong negotiation, leadership, and relationship-management skills

· Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region

**Skills Required**

· **Language:** Fluency in English (spoken and written) and Hindi is mandatory

· Strong local market knowledge and existing industry contacts preferred

· Working knowledge of MS Excel / CRM / sales reporting tools

Pay: ₹85,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Experience:

* Fuel Sales: 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Stock & Accounts Executive
description:
**Job Title: Stock & Accounts Executive**

**Company:** CASA SONNO LLP  
**Location:** Bhiwadi, Rajasthan  
**Salary:** ₹15,000–₹20,000 per month  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Industry:** Mattress Manufacturing

**Job Description**

We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented **Stock & Accounts Executive** to manage daily inventory operations, dispatch activities, data entry, and basic bookkeeping. The ideal candidate should have practical knowledge of stock handling, Tally, and MS Excel and be capable of managing routine tasks independently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain daily stock and inventory records.
* Manage stock inward/outward movements and dispatch documentation.
* Record purchase and sales transactions, bills, invoices, and related documents.
* Perform routine data entry and voucher entries in Tally.
* Update inventory and transaction records in MS Excel or other software.
* Verify physical stock against recorded balances and report discrepancies.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 1–2 years of relevant work experience.
* Practical experience in stock handling and dispatch operations.
* Basic working knowledge of Tally and MS Excel.
* Good record-keeping, data entry, and organisational skills.
* Ability to manage daily tasks independently and meet deadlines.

**Ideal Candidate**

A reliable and organised professional who can independently handle day-to-day stock management, dispatch documentation, and routine accounting entries with accuracy.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume along with the following details:

* **Current Salary**
* **Expected Salary**
* **Notice Period**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Location:

* Tapukrah, Rajasthan 301018 (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Sales Support Executive
description:
Experience: - candidates with 1 - 2 years of experience in sales support, sales coordination, logistics, or office administration will be preferred.

Salary Budget: - ₹18,000 – ₹25,000 per month.

Educational Qualification: - Graduate in any discipline.

Notice Period: - Immediate or less than 30 days will be Preferred.

Job Summary:-

We are looking for a Sales Support Executive to support the sales team with client coordination, material/document movement, data entry and day-to-day sales and office activities.

Job Key Skills & Competencies (Mandatory): -

Basic computer knowledge with proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and Email.

Good communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.

Willingness to travel locally for client visits and material/document collection or submission.

Two-wheeler preferred with a valid driving licence.

Knowledge of Bhiwadi and nearby industrial areas will be an advantage.

Comfortable with both office work and local field visits.

Good interpersonal skills and a customer-friendly attitude.

Responsible, organized, and able to manage multiple tasks independently.

Job Key Roles & Responsibilities: -

Visit clients for material and document collection/submission.

Coordinate delivery and pickup of materials/documents.

Coordinate with clients, logistics partners, and internal teams for timely deliveries and collections.

Maintain records of client visits, deliveries, pickups, and documents.

Perform data entry and basic MIS/record maintenance using MS Excel.

Follow up with clients and internal teams on pending documents, deliveries, and other requirements.

Provide general sales and administrative support to the sales team.

Assist with other day-to-day office and sales coordination activities as required.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
